thread:
Alex: Kicking off NorthBridge consumer-banking POC. Need scoping on use cases, golden prompts, eval harness, timeline, pricing asks, and security questionnaire blockers. Customer prefers Private (VPC/HSM) but is open to a hybrid approach for dev. 6-week target. Who can take what?

Maria: I can own the eval harness and goldens. Proposed target flows: (1) account-opening Q&A (document retrieval + short answers), (2) transaction-alert triage (classify + suggested next action), (3) customer intent routing for support chat. Do we lock these?

Devon: +1 on 1 and 2. Re AML/KYC summarization — legal flagged PII scope. Recommend we keep summarization out of public-hosted path; if the customer insists include only on Private with redaction.

Samir: Infra note: NorthBridge requires VPC peering, KMS-backed keys (HSM preferred), and no persistent per-token request logs. Private deployment works but sizing q: expected concurrency?

Alex: Sales estimates 120 qps peak during demo, 20 sustained. Also they asked if we can do hosted for initial onboarding and then move to Dedicated/Private for production. Pricing: want a PoC discount and a clear conversion quote.

Maria: For the harness: propose a golden dataset of ~200 examples per flow (mix of short/long, edge cases, multi-turn). Sample golden prompt templates below:```
# Account QA
User: "I uploaded ID and utility bill. Is additional verification needed?"
System: "Check ID expiry and address match. If mismatch, request updated proof."

# Transaction triage
User: "Large outbound to unknown payee at 3AM, balance OK"
System: "Label: Potential Fraud. Recommended action: Hold and escalate to ops."
```
I'll create a seed CSV with columns: id, flow, prompt, expected_answer, tags, acceptance_criteria.

Katie: Scoring rubric idea: combine exact-match for structured labels + semantic similarity for free text. Score each example 0-1. Pass criteria = average >= 0.8 on golden set AND at least 95% of label examples >= 0.9. Regression gate: fail the PoC if average drops >5% compared to baseline during A/B runs.

Devon: Also add a manual QA tier for top-20 low confidence outputs (model confidence < threshold) during demo. Ops team wants a reranker/second-pass model for critical flows.

Samir: For infra costs, recommend we propose two Dedicated GPUs (Nvidia A40/A100 class) for baseline plus ability to burst to hosted. For PoC we can offer 2-week Dedicated trial (no commit) then propose a 3-month reserved with 20% discount. This needs legal OK.

legal: Quick note — NorthBridge requires SOC2 attestation, data residency in us-east-1, IP indemnity clause ask. We need to get the security questionnaire answers ready (they already filed a 70-question questionnaire). @Alex please escalate to security for the PII/retention answers.

Alex: Action items: 1) Maria build seed golden CSV + scoring templates (ETA 3 business days). 2) Samir produce sizing + PoC Dedicated trial proposal (ETA 2 business days). 3) Dev to draft redaction/data handling plan for AML-related flows (ETA 4 days). 4) Katie to write scoring rubric doc and regression gate thresholds (ETA 3 days). 5) Legal to start security questionnaire (Alex to share questionnaire doc). Everyone add blockers here. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder — create a shared Google Drive folder for golden set and upload initial seed by EOD.

Maria: One more thing — for eval harness automation we should add: nightly regression run vs baseline, automatic alert if drop >3% (warn) or >5% (fail), and gated deploy for model version changes. I'll include these in the harness README.

Alex: Perfect — thanks. If anyone can't hit ETAs call out now. I'll set a 30-min sync tomorrow to review the first goldens.

Devon: Heads-up: customer security lead may ask for on-prem install. If that happens, our timelines slip by ~2 weeks.

Samir: noted. I'll add an on-prem contingency to the sizing doc.

legal: Uploaded partial answers to the drive (Q1-30). Will iterate.

Alex: great — closing thread for now, will reopen after the sync.
